capabilities.body: Ka whakamahere a OpenAmer i tētahi mahi, ka whakahaere mā ngā utauta tūturu — te kāpeka, te pūtirotiro, ngā kōnae, te waehere — ka pupuri hoki i ngā mea i whai hua.
capabilities.title: He māngai ka whakaaro tahi me koe

capabilities.body: Kei tēnei rorohiko ngā kōrerorero, te pūmahara me ngā tauira. Kāore he mea e tukuatu, ki te kore koe e tono.
capabilities.title: Ō pūmārō, ō raraunga

capabilities.body: 186 ngā reo, kei te momo tuhi e pānui ana koe. Ka pātai te mata tuatahi o te taupānga ko tēhea.
capabilities.title: Tō reo, kia tika

capabilities.body: Ka tiakina ngā pūkenga mai i ngā mahi tonu, nō reira ka tere ake ngā mahi o ia rā i a koe e whakamahi ana.
capabilities.title: He āheinga e tipu ana

help: Tirohia mēnā ka taea e tēnei rorohiko te hono ki te ipurangi.
Whakahaere anō i te tatūnga — kāore e tāruaruatia ngā hipanga kua oti.
Ki te rahua rua ngā wā, whakatuwheratia ngā rangitaki; kei ngā rārangi whakamutunga te ingoa o te hipanga.
failure.lead: Kāore he panonitanga i whakahokia puku — ka noho a OpenAmer ki te wāhi i tū ai, kia haere tonu ai te whakahaere tuarua mai i reira.
failure.leadUpdate: Kei te putanga o mua tonu a OpenAmer, ā, e mahi tonu ana. Kāore he mea i whakakapia haurua.
failure.title: Kāore te tatūnga i oti

language.lead: Ka haere tonu te tatūnga i te reo ka kōwhiria e koe i konei. Ka taea te huri ā muri ake i te taupānga.
language.title: Kōwhiria tō reo

progress.lead: Tatūnga kotahi anake: e tikiake ana a OpenAmer i ngā mea e hiahiatia ana, e whirihora ana hoki i tēnei rorohiko. Ka tīpoka ēnei katoa i ngā whakarewanga o muri.
progress.leadUpdate: E whakakapi ana a OpenAmer i te putanga o mua. Ka noho tonu ō wātū, tō pūmahara me ō tautuhinga.
progress.stepsComplete: Kua oti ngā hipanga {done} o te {total}
progress.title: E tatū ana i a OpenAmer
progress.titleUpdate: E whakahou ana i a OpenAmer

cards.body: Whakatuwheratia te taupānga, ka whakaahua i te mahi e hiahia ana koe kia oti. Ka mahi a OpenAmer ki muri, ka pūrongo mai.
cards.title: Tīmata ki tētahi rerenga kōrero

cards.body: Tautuhinga → Whakaaturanga → Reo. 186 ngā tautuhinga ā-rohe, ka taea te huri i ngā wā katoa.
cards.title: Kōwhiria tō reo

cards.body: Ka noho ngā mahi auau hei pūkenga — ā muri ake, kotahi noa te whakahau.
cards.title: Tukua kia maumahara

success.command: tīmatahia rānei ā muri ake mai i tētahi kāpeka:
success.errorTitle: Kāore i taea te whakarewa i te taupānga papamahi
success.lead: Kua rite katoa. Nōu a OpenAmer ināianei — kei tēnei rorohiko, kei tō reo.
success.title: Kua rite a OpenAmer

bullets: Ka whakahaere ā-roto — ka noho ō kōrerorero ki tēnei rorohiko

welcome.lead: Tō ake māngai. Kei ō pūmārō. Kei tō reo.
welcome.leadUpdate: Kua rite tētahi OpenAmer hōu ake. Ka whakakapi tēnei i te putanga o mua, ka pupuri hoki i ngā wātū me ngā tautuhinga katoa.
welcome.note: He meneti ruarua i runga i tētahi hononga noa.
welcome.title: Nau mai ki OpenAmer
